entries.name: 市井朱红
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a standalone collectible ingredient encyclopedia entry icon for the Chinese hotpot matching mini-game 锅里捞啥. Create a NEW icon, using the supplied existing game UI atlas ONLY as a material, lighting and color style reference, never reproduce the atlas. Exactly ONE complete icon in a square canvas with genuine transparent background. A beautiful open illustrated recipe collection book seen in a friendly elevated three-quarter view, broad thick ivory pages, a strong central fold, substantial dimensional cover and a short bookmark. A carefully painted appetizing red shrimp on the left page and a shiitake mushroom on the right page, integrated as embossed page illustrations. The open-book silhouette must dominate, recognizable at a 64–96 px display size. Rich polished casual game illustration, sculpted forms and confident large shapes, restrained details, gentle upper-left light, beautiful tactile materials. Center the icon, occupy about 82% of the canvas, keep all corners and bookmark inside a generous transparent safe margin. No lettering, no Chinese characters, no digits, no watermark, no frame around the canvas, no UI screenshot, no grid, no variants, no loose food surrounding the book. The image is design-only, not a code mockup. Theme: 市井朱红. Festive vermilion lacquer cover, deep emerald-green binding and bookmark, warm brass gilded corner guards, warm ivory pages. Match the dimensional red-and-gold restaurant signage and emerald panels in the reference. Tasteful small cloud-curl corner flourishes, premium antique brass highlights, lively but not gaudy. No jewels, no crown, no excessive sparkles.
